procedure: Measure the time from reset release to the first WDI falling edge over repeated resets, including a slow HSE start; scope WDG_STROBE for a 5 ms pulse every 10 ms; halt the CPU and read WDG_OK and the latch; withhold the strobe and read WDG_OK falling time; only then close JP1 and repeat a reset.
expected_result_and_evidence: First strobe edge within 23 ms of reset release in every reset (CCR-E11; TPS3430 tWDU min 23.4 ms); falling edges 10 ms apart; WDG_OK falls within 35 ms of a withheld strobe and the latch cannot be set with the CPU halted. The boot self-test remains not implemented; JP1 stays open if any reset exceeds 23 ms.
evidence_reference: electronics/chassis_main/STAGE2_CHANGE_REQUESTS.md section 3.1 F9, F18; electronics/analysis/chassis_safety_chain.md section 7; firmware/chassis/README.md; docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_BACKLOG.md IB-60
supporting_analysis: Datasheet limits verified (TI, fetched 2026-11-27); firmware timing simulated; nothing measured on a board.

title: Stop distance on a slope and with hot windings
prerequisites: Motors fitted, encoder log, tilt rig or ramp (slopes to 10 deg), winding temperature probe, brake resistor fitted; VT-045 rotor inertia and friction done first.
procedure: Brake from 0.05, 0.10 and 0.20 m/s on the level, on slopes in steps up to 10 deg (downhill and uphill), with cold windings and with windings heated to about 100 C; record stop distance, creep speed after the stop, and the hold angle; repeat after the magnets have been warmed.
expected_result_and_evidence: criterion not yet defined (chassis electronics + motion controls define the allowed distance and slope); calculated for comparison: from 0.20 m/s level 8.8 / 28.6 mm (nominal / conservative), with 100 C windings 9.8 / 34.2 mm (12.0 / 47.5 mm with magnet derating); holds a downhill slope up to about 3-6 deg (half friction) or 6-10 deg (nominal), beyond which it creeps at 12-36 mm/s.
supporting_analysis: Calculated and simulated (rotor inertia, the dominant input, is unpublished and unverified; model and emulator share constants, so agreement is consistency, not validation).

title: Cold box: head heater power at the +5 C set-point
prerequisites: Complete head (prototype and production) on its receiver or a thermal fixture in a cold chamber, instrumented NTCs on the spreader, SiPM carrier and housing, heater supplied at 12 V and 10 V with power logging, still air and 25 W/m2K moving air, jacket fitted and removed.
procedure: Soak at -20 and -25 C; run the heater regulation at the +5 C carrier set-point (and +10 C for comparison); log steady-state electrical power, warm-up time from a -25 C soak, and the carrier temperature lag; repeat with moving air and with the receiver channels on the thermal-break shim.
expected_result_and_evidence: Measured steady-state demand compared with the calculated 13.8 / 14.0 W (still air, -20 C), 16.7 / 17.0 W (-25 C), 21.2 / 21.5 W and 25.6 / 26.0 W at 25 W/m2K (prototype / production, plus +1.6 / +2.9 W body-side) and with the delivered heater power of 19.9 W at 10 V and 28.7 W at 12 V (IB-69); margin to the delivered power at 10 V is positive in still air; required margin criterion not yet defined (power budget owner). Warm-up compared with the calculated 49-52 min at 30 W and 96-105 min at 20.8 W.
evidence_reference: mechanical/head/out/head_report.md section 9; mechanical/head/out/thermal_summary.json; docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_BACKLOG.md IB-39, IB-62, IB-64, IB-69; docs/build/05_first_bench_tests.md T7
supporting_analysis: Calculated (lumped steady state, one assumption set; nothing measured). Optics supplier temperature limits unknown.

title: Receiver thermal break conductance
prerequisites: Receiver channel pair on a chassis plate with the G-10 shims, bushings, pins and spring washers as built (prototype and production), head or head-sized heated block, thermocouples on channel and plate.
procedure: Heat the channel to a set temperature above the plate and measure the heat flow through each shim joint (W/K per channel) and the body-side conductance per shoe at still air and 25 W/m2K; repeat after 100 latch cycles and after a hot-cold cycle.
expected_result_and_evidence: At most about 0.10 W/K per channel to the plate (proposal figure of IB-64; calculated 0.081 W/K, G-10 0.30 W/m K handbook, UNVERIFIED) and body-side per shoe compared with the calculated 0.11 / 0.14 W/K against the 0.07 W/K the head model assumes; if higher, head heater demand rises by the difference times the temperature rise (CR-10).
supporting_analysis: Calculated only (handbook conductivity).

title: Pack-to-body thermal coupling and bay pre-heat time
prerequisites: Pack in its cassette in the heated bay in a cold chamber, heater pad on the pack skin, pack and bay NTCs, external power for pre-heat.
procedure: Soak at -25 and -20 C; measure the pack-to-body coupling (W/K) with the pad on; pre-heat from the soak on external power to +5 C (charge gate) and record time and power; run the discharge hold at -10 C on pack power and record the bay power; repeat in moving air.
expected_result_and_evidence: Coupling compared with the 0.6 W/K ASSUMED; pre-heat time compared with the calculated 95-200 min from -25 C (pad on the pack skin 10-12.5 W; whole bay 28-41 W, pad insufficient); the -10 C hold at 0-7.8 W; criterion on the maximum acceptable pre-heat time criterion not yet defined (operations).
evidence_reference: docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_BACKLOG.md IB-64; interface/system/contract.yaml power.thermal_policy; mechanical/common/out/mech_calcs.md section 7
supporting_analysis: Calculated; the coupling coefficient is an assumption.

title: G-10 shim clamp creep and gap stability
prerequisites: Receiver channel, G-10 shims, bushings, pins and DIN 6796 washers as built, torque wrench, load cell or washer-load gauge, thermal chamber, gap gauge at datum C.
procedure: Tighten the M4 screws to 1.2 N m (about 1500 N preload); measure preload and gap at datum C after 1 h, 24 h, 1 week, and after 20 cycles between -25 C and +50 C; repeat without the spring washers to confirm the calculated difference; measure land-height tolerance of the ground shims.
expected_result_and_evidence: Preload loss of at most about 6 % with the spring washers (calculated; 57 % without) and datum C gap change within the calculated tolerance band of +-1.58 mm; a larger loss means re-torque intervals or a different washer. Pass limit for the gap change: criterion not yet defined (body mechanical).
supporting_analysis: Calculated (G-10 creep data and DIN 6796 data UNVERIFIED).

title: Heat-set insert pull-out coupons
prerequisites: Coupons in the printed material (PAHT-CF, ASA) and in SLS PA11 with the M3, M4 inserts as used, tensile rig.
procedure: Make at least 5 coupons per material and insert type with the installation tool and temperature used for the build; pull the inserts out at room temperature and at -20 C at a stated rate; record failure load and failure mode (insert, thread, material).
expected_result_and_evidence: Pull-out of at least 600 N (the value used in the design, UNVERIFIED); if lower, the affected joints are re-checked.
supporting_analysis: Design value only; no coupon made.

title: Isolation tests: frame to receiver unmated (E7), mated bond check (E7M), heater circuit to frame
prerequisites: Assembled head (both builds), 100 V DC insulation tester (never mated), four-wire milliohm meter at 100 mA or less, F2801 removable.
procedure: E7 (harness label): with J1 and J2 unmated, head on the receiver or bench with the receiver metal contacted, frame to receiver metal at 100 V DC. E7M: mated, four-wire resistance frame to chassis GND at the J1 receptacle shell at 100 mA or less (F2801 + R2801 + about 0.44 m of AWG 20/18 + contact pairs); record the real fuse resistance. Heater circuit (head checklist E2, harness W-103.HTR-ISO): assembled head, spreader bolted to the board, board disconnected, J2601 pins 1, 2, 3 and NTC pins 4/5 to FRAME and to GND at 100 V DC; then with F2801 fitted and the heater cycling, read MON_ADC.
expected_result_and_evidence: E7 at least 10 Mohm; heater circuit to frame at least 10 Mohm at 100 V; isolated-case cut-out at least 100 Mohm case to terminals; E7M expected to be dominated by the fuse, well under 2 ohm (UNVERIFIED; if the chassis board GND is not bonded to chassis metal the mated reading is at least 1 Mohm through the drain network; whether it is bonded is not stated). Label note: the lead's shorthand "E9" is not the heater test; see README_0.4.md contradiction C-09.
evidence_reference: harness/cables.md section 8; electronics/analysis/head_design_review_checklist.md E1, E2; electronics/head_acq/STAGE2_CHANGE_REQUESTS.md S3-03, L-01, L-05; docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_BACKLOG.md IB-38, IB-63
supporting_analysis: Tool-checked geometry only (minimum frame-to-receiver metal gap 0.50 mm prototype, 0.30 mm production); nothing measured; fuse resistance not in any source.

title: Motor-terminal suppression effectiveness
prerequisites: Robot or motor rig with the head in position, suppression parts fitted at the terminals as in RQ-100, then removed; VT-049 capture available; LCR meter for the capacitor check (labels W-006.SUP, W-007.SUP).
procedure: With and without suppression: capture at FCMP triggered on motor PWM states, brush-only states (DC supply at 100 %, back-driven with bridges asleep) and brake-relay transitions; compare the brush-arc amplitude with the calculated 2.76 p.e. open / 0.11 p.e. coax and the review's about 20 / 0.6; record whether the can strap and the encoder-pair routing change the result.
expected_result_and_evidence: criterion not yet defined (head electronics lead; bound in p.e. at the comparator input). The two independent estimates of brush-arc pickup differ by a factor of about 7 and the measurement decides between them; suppression is judged by the measured ratio with and without parts.
evidence_reference: electronics/head_acq/STAGE2_CHANGE_REQUESTS.md S3-H H-01; docs/reviews/REVIEW_head_interference.md M4; electronics/analysis/head_afe_calc_out.md T16; harness/cables.md section 7
supporting_analysis: Calculated (two estimates, aggressor values assumed). No suppression part is selected or fitted.

title: Null-reference window behaviour on real data
prerequisites: Real count records (gate-by-gate with reference and floor counts) from a representative floor in a photon field with gradients, including a door step, stationary recounts and a source-free clean floor.
procedure: Replay the records through the revision-4 processing with window lengths of 20, 100, 200 and 400 T_F; record the false-flag fraction on the clean floor at the cell level, the bias of U_null in a field gradient, the behaviour of stationary recounts, and the detection limit D# versus window length.
expected_result_and_evidence: False-flag fraction at cell level not above the stored alpha for 2 and 4 contributing lanes; the 200 T_F figure is confirmed or restated in reference counts (radiometry owner); acceptable bias of U_null in a gradient criterion not yet defined (radiometry). Simulated reference: median cell D# 0.128 Bq/cm2 on s01 (synthetic coefficients).
supporting_analysis: Calculated and simulated with synthetic coefficients only; no real data used.

title: Undecidable-cell fraction per survey method
prerequisites: Mock floor or recorded scenario data for each survey method, scan speeds and dwell times as planned, revision-4 processing build.
procedure: Run each survey method over mock-floor data and count cells ending "no decision - null reference unavailable" and "no decision - evaluator check failed"; vary scenario length (46 s, 230-460 s, 580-1100 s) and the recount procedure; record where the undecided area lies.
expected_result_and_evidence: criterion not yet defined (radiometry owner sets the maximum undecidable fraction per method). Simulated reference: about 12 % of cells in 230-460 s scenarios, 0 in 580-1100 s, 40 of 44 in a 46 s run; stationary recounts have no usable window.
supporting_analysis: Simulated (synthetic coefficients).

title: Localisation transient on the native emulators (IB-47)
prerequisites: Native emulators built from the firmware cores, scenario s01 and s02 with truth, plant and odometry time-base logs, an idle host; bring-up fixed (VT-068).
procedure: Reproduce the x error against truth; log chassis time, host arrival time, encoder sample time and plant step; vary the emulator step size and load; find the cause of the 12-34 mm transient; repeat on hardware with an independent position reference.
expected_result_and_evidence: Position error at the detector row stays within 10 mm (2 sigma) at every instant (position budget); cause identified and recorded. Simulated reference: maximum x error 34.3 mm (s01) and 27.1 mm (s02) by chassis time, 34.5 / 27.3 mm by arrival time; under 2 mm on the Python fakes.
supporting_analysis: Simulated; cause unexplained.

title: No automatic resumption of motion after a hardware inhibit
prerequisites: Chassis emulator and then RR-CHS-MAIN stage-3 board, host bridge node, mission running, fault injection for E-stop, bumper, head loop, watchdog and MCU reset.
procedure: During a streamed DRIVE mission trigger each hardware inhibit, FAULT and MCU reset, then clear the cause and re-arm locally; observe whether the host re-sends DRIVE before an explicit operator command; repeat with the head reset.
expected_result_and_evidence: Zero DRIVE accepted by the chassis between the return to ARMED_IDLE and the explicit operator command; the interrupted segment is marked aborted in the record (ICD section 9).
supporting_analysis: Not run on the composed path: the native-emulator scenarios currently fail in bring-up against the stage-3 chassis firmware (IB-46).

title: Native-emulator scenario bring-up against the stage-3 chassis firmware
prerequisites: Workspace and test harness updated to ICD section 9 (wait for rearm_ready about 2 s after the chain closes; brake test about 2.2 s, reply timeout at least 3 s), native emulators rebuilt.
procedure: Run native n01, native_s01 and native_s02 on an idle host and on a loaded host (chassis link on its own thread), twice each; include a head stall of 0.5 s.
expected_result_and_evidence: All native scenarios pass on both loads; largest DRIVE gap with a 0.5 s head stall about 25 ms (TTL 200 ms, simulated reference); the n01 failure PREREQUISITES CHASSIS_MODE:STANDBY does not recur.
supporting_analysis: Currently FAILING in bring-up (lead run 2026-11-27); the earlier pass runs predate the stage-3 firmware.

title: Look-sensor pair behaviour by direction of travel
prerequisites: Robot on the guarded floor rig with a floor edge, ToF driver integrated (IB-04), nominal brake model replaced by measured stops where available.
procedure: Drive forward at 0.20 m/s toward a floor edge and in reverse at 0.05 m/s toward a threshold; confirm the pair facing travel acts (LOOK_FL/FR forward, LOOK_RL/RR rearward) and the other pair does not; measure the stop position against the available distance.
expected_result_and_evidence: Robot stops short of the edge with a margin: simulated reference 267 of 285 mm forward at 0.20 m/s (18 mm margin) and 182 of 201 mm rearward at 0.05 m/s (nominal brake model); required measured margin criterion not yet defined (chassis firmware + site safety).
supporting_analysis: Simulated; the ToF driver is a stub, so on hardware all ToF sensors are OFFLINE until IB-04 is closed. Extends VT-004.

title: As-built tail radius, grip position and carry hang angle
prerequisites: Prototype body as built (grip bar at x = -30 mm), head fitted, then production body when built; turntable or swept-circle gauge; a hanging fixture with an angle gauge.
procedure: Measure the swept radius of the tail including the rear bumper; measure the grip bar position; hang the robot from the grip with the prototype head, the production head and without a head and read the angle.
expected_result_and_evidence: Tail radius at most 0.290 m (calculated 289.2 mm, tool-checked on nominal CAD); hang angle at most 10 deg with a head (calculated -10.2 deg prototype head, -7.3 deg production head, -8.7 deg production body; -37.3 deg without a head); a result above 10 deg is reported against the target.
supporting_analysis: Calculated and tool-checked on nominal CAD; nothing measured.

title: Head heater contact rating and protection gap
prerequisites: Manufacturer drawing and rating for the Micro-Fit 3.0 43030-0007 terminal at AWG 20 (request or fetch), crimped sample, head heater harness as built, 12 V and 10 V supplies, thermocouple on the terminal.
procedure: Verify the terminal rating at AWG 20 from the manufacturer document; measure heater current at 10, 12 and 14.6 V; measure the terminal temperature rise at the maximum heater current for 1 h; test the head firmware cut at 3.2 A for 300 ms and the chassis branch trip (3.56-4.35 A) with a current-limited fault load between 3.13 and 3.56 A.
expected_result_and_evidence: Terminal rating (manufacturer) is at least the maximum heater current plus a margin set by the head electronics lead; temperature rise within the contact limit; otherwise apply a remedy of RQ-101 before first heater-on at 12 V. Calculated: heater up to 3.04 A; delivered 19.9 W at 10 V and 28.7 W at 12 V; rating about 3.13 A continuous UNVERIFIED (recalled ~5 A in the earlier text).
evidence_reference: docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_BACKLOG.md IB-69, IB-61; electronics/head_acq/STAGE2_CHANGE_REQUESTS.md heater-pair contact decision; harness/parts_status.md
supporting_analysis: Calculated; contact rating recalled (UNVERIFIED, one Molex fetch failed).

title: Cold test of caster and tyre at -20 and -25 C
prerequisites: Complete drive and caster as built (TENTE caster; TPU and PU tyres), cold chamber, a test floor surface, drawbar load cell.
procedure: Soak at -10, -20 and -25 C; measure caster swivel and rolling resistance, tyre traction (drawbar pull at slip) and wheel behaviour on a test floor; inspect after the soak.
expected_result_and_evidence: Operating limit stated per part; objective -25 C met or the limit written down. The caster is rated -20 C (plain bearing); TPU traction below -10 C and PU 85A cold hardness are not assumed (UNVERIFIED); pass limits criterion not yet defined (mechanical).
supporting_analysis: Datasheet limits and handbook only.

title: Production-body supplier capability: SLS envelope, PA11, PU 85A, G-10
prerequisites: Quotation request with the STEP files and drawings of the 44 made parts; supplier datasheets; first-article part.
procedure: Obtain written confirmation of the large-frame SLS envelope (700 x 380 x 580 mm) and nested envelope, the PA11 and PU 85A cold properties, G-10 data and the washer data; measure a first-article lower hull and upper shell for flatness and fit to the plate.
expected_result_and_evidence: Supplier confirmation covers every made part (45/45 fit by tool check against unverified envelopes); first article within the drawing tolerances (limits criterion not yet defined on the sheets that are not dimensioned: only the plate, receiver channel and shim sheets are fully dimensioned).
supporting_analysis: Tool-checked against UNVERIFIED supplier envelopes.

title: Multi-hour step-and-count mission in the cold chamber
prerequisites: Complete robot with the 12 Ah pack and a spare, cold chamber large enough for the robot or a representative load rig with measured pack current, mission supervisor with pack-swap procedure, VT-040 results.
procedure: Run a step-and-count mission profile (5 s and 10 s counts, 1600 and 3000 stations) at -20 C with the thermal policy of RQ-093; log energy by branch, heater duty, pack temperature, swaps and datum re-registrations.
expected_result_and_evidence: Energy and swaps compared with the calculated mission times (5.2-9.7 h) and the calculated 139 min per pack at -20 C; criterion on usable energy and the maximum number of swaps criterion not yet defined (power budget owner).
supporting_analysis: Calculated mission times; heater and pack data calculated or assumed.

title: Register-map and pinout read-back on hardware
prerequisites: Populated boards, manufacturer documents obtained (RQ-074), drivers for LTC4162-F, TCA9534/TCA9535, MCP23S17, TLV3201 test fixture, BMI088, VL53L4ED.
procedure: Read back identification and configuration registers of each device against the manufacturer map; exercise each expander pin through its readback; check the TCA9534 output-register power-up value and the pin polarities of the IOX_D fixed pattern (P4 = 1, P5-P7 = 0); read the BMI088 chip ID; check the LTC4162-F cell-count strap and JEITA defaults; confirm the TLV3201 output polarity.
expected_result_and_evidence: Every register map and pin table agrees with the manufacturer document; every mismatch is recorded and the firmware constants corrected; the LTC4162 driver is enabled only after this test (CHARGER_COMM raised until then).
evidence_reference: docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_BACKLOG.md IB-05, IB-06, IB-15, IB-60; electronics/chassis_main/STAGE2_CHANGE_REQUESTS.md section 3.4; firmware/chassis/README.md
supporting_analysis: Register tables recalled (UNVERIFIED); INA228 and INA3221 decoders were written against TI datasheet values (simulated).

title: J1 harness fit inside the head: wire exit behind the mated plugs and thin-wall AWG 20 fan-in
prerequisites: Head housing (prototype), RR-HEAD-ACQ or a dimensioned mock-up with J2001/J2601 7 mm forward, mated Micro-Fit plugs, thin-wall AWG 20 wire (OD at most 1.6 mm prototype / 1.75 mm production), the J1 pigtail cable (OD 7.5 mm) and grommet, lid.
procedure: Build the J1 harness inside the head; check the wire exit and bend behind the mated plugs (9.0 mm available behind them with the stage-3 board against about 8 mm estimated need, 2.1 mm wire OD, UNVERIFIED), the fan-in of J2001 wires to the 7.5 mm cable at the port, the 8.9 mm blister and the lid closure with the J2 plug keep-out at J2501.
expected_result_and_evidence: Harness fits without strain; wires keep their minimum bend radius; lid closes on the blister with the 8.3 mm header and plug stack (Micro-Fit right-angle seated height UNVERIFIED); minimum bend radius value criterion not yet defined (harness).
supporting_analysis: Calculated fan-in check passes with thin-wall AWG 20 (head mechanical); wire OD and exit allowance are estimates.

title: ARM refusal until device type and thresholds are set
prerequisites: Head firmware on the target (and the emulator with --strict-placeholders), host able to send ENG_SETUP_SET.
procedure: Send ARM with the default setup; set device to each of the six types and send ARM with and without thresholds_confirmed; check STATUS device, thresholds_confirmed and alpha_tot_ns and that setup_id changes.
expected_result_and_evidence: ARM answers FAULT with reason device_type_unset or placeholder_thresholds until both are satisfied; effective TOT cut equals the per-device value (290 / 180 / 215 / 190 / 200 / 655 ns) or the override.
supporting_analysis: Simulated and tool-checked in the head check.sh only.

title: Monitor multiplexers off while armed (MON_LANE_EN)
prerequisites: RR-HEAD-ACQ with firmware, TCA9534 U2405, scope on TP2402 and FCMP, VT-049 capture.
procedure: While armed read MON_LANE_EN (TP2402) low and confirm no switch toggles at the comparator input with MON_MUX_A[2:0] scanning; power up and reset with U2405 absent or in reset; check the write order (output bit 7 = 0 before P7 is an output); scan the anode-current monitor while armed; capture with MON_LANE_EN = 1 for the engineering case.
expected_result_and_evidence: All four lane muxes off whenever armed, with U2405 absent, unconfigured or in reset; no injection above the bound set in VT-049 (criterion not yet defined); calculated injection 0 off, 0.013-0.13 p.e. on.
evidence_reference: electronics/head_acq/STAGE2_CHANGE_REQUESTS.md S3-01, S3-02; electronics/analysis/head_afe_calc_out.md T15; docs/reviews/REVIEW_head_interference.md M2
supporting_analysis: Calculated (T15); TCA9534 register map and power-up value recalled (UNVERIFIED).

title: Frame-bond fuse and frame-potential monitoring
prerequisites: Assembled head with F2801 and R2801 fitted, a deliberately inserted heater-to-spreader leak (return-side and feed-side) through a resistor, MON_ADC readout, firmware with the frame rule.
procedure: Store the MON_ADC value at arm; insert a return-side leak and read the shift (expected +35 to +45 mV); insert a feed-side contact and observe whether F2801 opens and MON_ADC rises to the clamp; check heater-off and the health code; confirm the firmware thresholds (30 mV rise, +-60 mV window).
expected_result_and_evidence: Return-side leak raises MON_ADC by more than 15 mV and the heater turns off with the frame-fault code; feed-side contact opens F2801 (limits the sneak to about 0.24 A, calculated) and is detected; the firmware thresholds are replaced by measured values.
supporting_analysis: Calculated (head checklist E3); firmware thresholds derived, not measured; F2801 MPN and I2t UNVERIFIED.
